Lemma
[Weak derivatives commute with mollification] 1. ch7:7.3\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0162 If $u\in L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega )$ and $D^\alpha u$ exists, then, whenever $\dist (x,\partial \Omega )>h$, \begin{equation} \tag {7.17} D^\alpha u_h(x)=(D^\alpha u)_h(x). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the convolution kernel in $x$, replace its $x$-derivative by the signed $y$-derivative, and apply (7.16).

□
